```yaml
name: Publish to Ubuntu PPA

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y cargo-deb dput gnupg2

      - name: Build .deb package
        run: cargo deb

      - name: Find .deb and .changes files
        id: files
        run: |
          DEB_FILE=$(find target/debian -name '*.deb' | head -n 1)
          CHANGES_FILE=$(find target/debian -name '*.changes' | head -n 1)
          echo "deb_file=$DEB_FILE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "changes_file=$CHANGES_FILE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Import PPA GPG key
        env:
          PPA_KEY: ${{ secrets.PPA_KEY }}
        run: |
          echo "$PPA_KEY" > ppa-key.asc
          gpg --import ppa-key.asc

      - name: Create dput configuration
        env:
          PPA_REPO: ${{ secrets.PPA_REPO }}
        run: |
          echo "[${PPA_REPO}]" > .dput.cf
          echo "fqdn = uploads.launchpad.net" >> .dput.cf
          echo "port = 22" >> .dput.cf
          echo "proto = ssh" >> .dput.cf
          echo "user = ubuntu" >> .dput.cf
          echo "login = ubuntu" >> .dput.cf

      - name: Upload to PPA
        env:
          PPA_REPO: ${{ secrets.PPA_REPO }}
        run: |
          dput $PPA_REPO ${{ steps.files.outputs.changes_file }}
```
